title: A height-zero diagram represents a closed braid
statement:
Assume AC. If $h(D)=0$ for an oriented diagram $D$, its oriented link is
equivalent to the closure of an explicitly read-off braid. For a nonempty
diagram, an isotopy of its Seifert picture on $S^2$ and a choice of planar
chart put its Seifert circles in one nested chain about a point $p$, with
compatible orientations. Reading its signed crossing strips in angular order
from a cut ray at $p$ gives a finite Artin word whose closure is the link of
$D$. The empty diagram gives the empty word in $B_0$ and the empty closure.
strategy: Complementary dual tree has degree≤2 by pairwise coherence signs, hencepath; choosepole in enddisk onS2, withoutconnectedness assumption. Local Jordan-side argument excludes selfstrips; strips join consecutivecircles and preservecyclicorders. Finite smooth collar/roundedpolygon/triangle isotopies straighten circles and disjointstrips; annularwindings removed with innerdiskrotation, not invalidboundaryfixedDehntwist. Insert compatibleeventangles inductively, interpolatepositiveangularlifts, recover signedhalf twist models. Normalcollar lift gives ambientlinkequivalence. Read angularword with fixed rightmostfirstproduct. n0/n1 explicit. Statements clarifyS2/chart, not falsefixedplaneonly nesting.
